cards.kicker: United States Grand Prix · Race · 56 laps
cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 51 on-track passes, 32 pit stops, 3 cars that never finished, 2 virtual safety cars.

cards.title: 18 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Ocon and Albon gained the most by the end of it, 3 places each
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 5 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: Lap 1: Lindblad and Sainz, an incident
2 ended in a penalty and 3 in no further action

cards.title: Bortoleto starts P21. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 56 laps to make up ground from there.
cards.reveal: Out of the points. The exact place comes at the flag.

cards.title: Lap 2: contact between Bearman and Gasly at Turn 13. What do you give?
cards.text: Race control has flagged it and it lands on your desk. If one driver is to blame, what does he get? Same call the stewards had to make.

outcomes.none: You let it go. Nobody loses a place at a desk, and the driver behind spends the rest of the race on the radio.
outcomes.5: Five seconds gets added at the next stop, or to the final time if there is no stop left. Usually one position, sometimes none.
outcomes.10: Ten seconds is a real punishment and it almost always costs track position, which is why teams argue so hard about it.

cards.reveal: The stewards gave Bearman a 10s penalty.

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Antonelli was leading when it was called
Lifted on lap 2
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 7 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sector 9 saw 6 calls, more than anywhere else

cards.title: 28 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Russell lost 4 that way, more than anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.title: 2 penalties handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Russell: a 5s penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage
Bearman: a 10s penalty for causing a collision
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: Colapinto: 6 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 7 to lap 12, at racing speed.
bullets: 1 other driver had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Track at 37°C at the start, falling to 35°C at the flag
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Bortoleto: 8 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in an Audi.
bullets: P21 on the grid, P13 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Leclerc on lap 42, 1:37.976, in a Ferrari.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: You are Hadjar, 0.4s behind Verstappen. Now what?
cards.text: Stuck behind another car your tyres overheat and the car will not turn. Stopping first gives you clean track for two or three laps, which is the whole trick behind the undercut.

choices.label: Box now and undercut
choices.sub: Fresh tyres, clean air, two laps to make it pay

choices.label: Stay out and overcut
choices.sub: Let him stop first, then push on an empty track

choices.label: Forget strategy, pass him
choices.sub: Send it and take the risk

outcomes.box: You spend about 24s in the lane and come out in traffic, trusting that two fast laps on new tyres are worth more than the place you just gave up.
outcomes.wait: You stay on old rubber while he gets new ones, and you need clean air plus a mistake from him to make it work.
outcomes.attack: Passing a car with the same tyres on the same fuel is the hardest thing in the sport, and running into the back of him ends both races.

cards.reveal: Hadjar came in on lap 25, 1 lap after this.

cards.title: 32 stops, and the busiest lap saw 3 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 15, with 3 cars in
Shortest time in the pit lane: Piastri, 23.4s
Longest: Alonso, 40.4s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Bearman is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 25 of 56, in a Haas.
bullets: P22 at the start of lap 24
Started P13
1 on-track pass before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Russell and Alonso hit 349 km/h
cards.text: The trap reads one fixed point on the lap, so a car can go faster elsewhere. And the fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine

cards.title: Antonelli takes the lead from Leclerc
cards.text: A pass for the lead, made on track at racing speed.

cards.title: 49 blue flags waved
cards.text: That is how often a lapped car was told to let the leaders through.

cards.title: Colapinto is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 36 of 56, in an Alpine.
bullets: P19 at the start of lap 35
Started P20
1 on-track pass before it happened

cards.title: Antonelli had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Leclerc: 1:37.976
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Ferrari.
bullets: Set on lap 42 of 56, in the second half, with the car already lighter than at the start
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.

cards.title: Bottas is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 49 of 56, in a Cadillac.
bullets: P20 at the start of lap 48
Started P19

cards.title: Alonso went the other way: 4 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P12 on the grid, P16 at the flag
2 stops when most of the field made 1
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 56 of them

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Antonelli was leading when it was called
Bortoleto took a stop under it
Lifted on lap 53
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: Bortoleto: P21 on the grid, P13 at the flag
cards.text: 8 places gained.
bullets: 8 on-track passes along the way
3 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: How far behind was Leclerc at the flag?
cards.text: 56 laps, 1 hour 35 minutes of racing. Put a number on the gap to the winner.
cards.reveal: 13.078 seconds after 56 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 24s today, which is 1.9 times this gap.

cards.title: Piastri ran one set for 41 laps
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the hards, lap 16 to lap 56
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: Antonelli wins it
cards.text: P1 Antonelli · P2 Leclerc · P3 Verstappen.
bullets: After 56 laps, Leclerc crossed the line 13.078s behind
